resources.string: AppOps state unavailable on this ROM.
Android reported no AppOps entries for this package.

AppOps are separate from manifest permissions. uid is the mode set for the app uid, package is the mode set for this package. A uid mode takes precedence, so package changes are blocked while one is set. Changes run one operation at a time and are read back from Android. Protected apps, OEM operations such as MIUIOP(n) and the uid scope of system uids are refused. If the output cannot be split into uid and package scope, every reported mode is listed and changes are disabled. AppOps changes are not part of snapshots; the result card shows the previous mode.
default hands control back to the normal permission state. The new mode is read back from Android and is reported applied only if it matches.
Android returned success but kept the previous mode. The system silently ignored this change.
